question: Does Nemotron reranking bring articles that the literature gate accepts (focus/reported) into the top 6 read?

queries.q1_question: Does {drug} cause {pt}? adverse drug reaction case report or study
queries.q2_induced: {drug}-induced {pt}: case reports, clinical trials, cohort or pharmacovigilance studies reporting {pt} as an adverse effect of {drug} in patients
queries.q3_plain: {pt} as an adverse drug reaction to {drug} in humans

label_source: Jev literature gate (addresses), same wording as api/_fv/literature.py; focus/reported = relevant

chosen.query: {drug}-induced {pt}: case reports, clinical trials, cohort or pharmacovigilance studies reporting {pt} as an adverse effect of {drug} in patients
chosen.note: Chosen among three phrasings on this same set; the three differ by at most 0.022 in P@6 at pool 20, so the gain comes from reranking, not from the phrasing. The reranker (one call) is used instead of embedding cosine (two calls), which scored about the same.
